item.title: Secure Agent Workspace
item.description: This pattern gives each user an isolated AI agent workspace in their own OpenShift Virtualization VM, running NVIDIA OpenShell and OpenClaw agents with OIDC sign-in, governed sandbox policy, and API keys kept in Vault.
